summary: The 8-K discloses cash flow projections in connection with Amendment No. 2 to Form S-4 for an exchange offer already announced. The registrant, Terra Property Trust, is offering to exchange unsecured 6.00% Senior Notes due 2026 for new 11.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 plus cash. The filing provides projected inflows (e.g., $47.1M) and outflows (e.g., $51.9M) under participation scenarios, but no new event or structural change. This is a supplemental disclosure to a previously announced exchange, not a standalone special situation.
